statement: Admin service-discovery contract fixtures represent successful authoritative gateway reads with gateway-issued complete-table observation receipts and successful reconcile publication results, so the admin contract suite exercises the same owner boundary as production.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
This child Quest may change only the admin service-discovery contract test fixtures and its own Solver artifacts; production behavior remains owned by the parent Quest.
